summary: Sound Financial Bancorp, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on July 28, 2026, reporting second quarter 2026 earnings and declaring a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per share, payable August 21, 2026, to shareholders of record August 7, 2026. The filing is routine operational reporting, including net income of $2.5 million and diluted EPS of $0.98 for the quarter. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. The dividend is ordinary and not a special capital return. This filing is a standard earnings release and dividend declaration, not a special situation.
